name: Headless Horsetoon
source:
Headless Horsetoon is a mysterious figure who is the protagonist of the intermission sections. He exists outside of the killing game. 

[spoiler]He conspires with [url=/c143325]Doctor Surlee[/url] to infiltrate the killing game, and just might be joining it soon...[/spoiler]
